title: Preallocate single-column index metadata values
description: Replace legacy table:column index metadata format! construction with a shared exact-capacity Executor helper.

criteria: CREATE INDEX and ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY use the shared helper
execution/storage contains no format!("{}:{}") metadata construction
Index and DDL regression tests pass

notes: The helper lives next to composite metadata helpers and parse_index_meta.
DDL CREATE INDEX and ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY now share the same single-column metadata serialization path.
Generated metadata remains the legacy table:column value consumed by parse_index_meta.
